# Real current target/payment relation, portable State9

`activate_target_payment_real_v9.json` was derived from the frozen owner-local
7,718,945-byte MP52 Equip capture, SHA256
`6bab453be2830750af3983a70ce4843f747252ef950e1e4ced628785d7cfac07`.
The exact request-only prefix ends at7,664,967 bytes, SHA256
`e8a8732c67e8bd4a9c019ec042aae7d067efc54b7797576b8ce53b4d1ffd2635`.

`before_response` is the single existing producer's State9 at authentic own
request1402/message1, before response1421. All17 original offered positions are
retained; position6 is the targeted Activate, with its offered own public target,
ability-bound Generic2 and two distinct predictive Blue units. Corresponding
unique active mana witnesses are12 and14. All five identifiers/observed flags,
source ability pair status and option/selection relations agree in this request.
`after_response` is the current snapshot in the actual1421 consumption poll;
its request is null and the prior relation is unavailable. Scope equality was
checked on the original projections before aliasing. No future result supplies
current payment or target evidence.

Only aliases are published: separate object/card/ability/unique-ability/facet/
request/state/zone/slot/mana namespaces, a synthetic match name and normalized
game/generation. Every card_id, card knowledge, source byte offset and timestamp
is null. Order, row positions, enums, booleans, shapes and current nullable tap
literals are retained. Both payment sources have tapped=null; this is unknown,
never proof of untappedness. Alias maps, raw bytes, names/accounts, hidden objects,
screenshots and private diagnostics remain ignored. Old fixtures are unchanged.

Canonical UTF-8/LF JSON is143,300 bytes, SHA256
`3a33fdded8bda6e62899137466f6e5e17ba34199e4fdf2dbe5b77c03fe7b960d`.
Windows checkout newline conversion may differ; this hash describes LF content.
Both states pass the portable runtime and formal State9 schemas. The positive
is a real offered-target/predictive-route association; all test mutations and
transport envelopes are explicitly synthetic. No public artifact authenticates
the private raw source or grants payability, full legality, acceptance or input.
See [the evidence/contract limits](../../docs/current-target-payment.md).
